ELOQUENT Preference Prediction

dataset.eloquent-preference-prediction

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual complete primary creator card and task protocol reads establish the ELOQUENT2025PreferencePrediction dataset family, with human preferences and explanations collected from scratch onToloka, five criteria, four label choices, explicit dev/test stages and prediction/explanation scoring. Original qualified source-bound facts have actual distinct author/verifier/adversarial current-digest receipts; no new scientific passes. No annotator eligibility,multiplicity,adjudication,agreement or instruction/response provenance is inferred. Retain card truthfulness-field copied relevance wording as an unresolved documentation error, PaperTBA, and distinct dev Gemma2-9B versus finalGPT4o judge disclosures. MITcard statement is reported, not blanket clearance of upstream model outputs. Full_source means complete available named family creation/evaluation documentation, not corpus audit, a nonexistent paper review or independent QA/metric replication.
